name: bytebase-mcp
description: Official MCP server for Bytebase, the open-source database governance platform. Query data, inspect schemas and propose database changes through your Bytebase instance, under its approval flow, access control, data masking and audit logging.

BYTEBASE_URL.description: External URL of your Bytebase instance. Sign-in is OAuth in the browser, so there is no API key.

tools.name: administer_workspace
tools.description: Make a workspace administration change that the user confirms in this client first.

tools.name: decide_issue
tools.description: Approve or reject a Bytebase issue at its current approval step.

tools.name: get_gitops_workflow
tools.description: Return the workflow files that set up GitOps for a project.

tools.name: grant_masking_exemption
tools.description: Exempt one member from data masking in a Bytebase project, for one database (optionally one schema, table, or columns of one table) or for every database in the project.

tools.name: propose_database_change
tools.description: Run DDL/DML changes (ALTER TABLE, CREATE TABLE, INSERT, UPDATE, migrations) against a Bytebase database.

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Execute a SQL query against a Bytebase database.

tools.name: reauthorize
tools.description: Log out the current MCP OAuth connection so the client can run OAuth again.

tools.name: request_access_grant
tools.description: Request an access grant: time-boxed permission to run one read-only statement on one Bytebase database, optionally with results unmasked or exported.

tools.name: revoke_masking_exemption
tools.description: Remove one member's masking exemption in a Bytebase project.

tools.name: set_just_in_time_access
tools.description: Turn just-in-time access on or off for one Bytebase project.
